notes: against is placed with αὐτῆς under rule 106's oblique-case arm, the ASV having written prevail as the compound's own verb word; keeping against inside the verb's unit as a realization of the κατα- preverb remains defensible.
κἀγώ takes both I and also as one unit headed on the pronominal (rule 55), and the verse-opening And is δέ's.
The demonstrative ταύτῃ takes this and the article τῇ is unrepresented under rule 38.
